class HelpRefused(RuntimeError):

        return result
    if context == 'mach-lookup' and re.fullmatch(
            r'com\.apple\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,159}', value):
        return {'recognized': True, 'kind': 'apple_mach_service', 'value': value}
    if context == 'sysctl-read' and re.fullmatch(
            r'(?:hw|kern|vm|security)\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.]{0,127}', value):
        return {'recognized': True, 'kind': 'public_sysctl_name', 'value': value}
    if value.startswith('@rpath/') and re.fullmatch(
            r'lib[A-Za-z0-9_+.-]{1,120}\.dylib', value[7:]):
        return {'recognized': True, 'kind': 'public_rpath_library', 'value': value}
    prefixes = ('/System/Library/', '/System/Cryptexes/OS/',
                '/System/Volumes/Preboot/Cryptexes/OS/',
                '/private/preboot/Cryptexes/OS/', '/usr/lib/',
                '/private/var/db/dyld/')
    library_prefixes = ('/opt/homebrew/Cellar/', '/opt/homebrew/lib/',
                        '/opt/homebrew/opt/')
    prefix = next((p for p in prefixes + library_prefixes if value.startswith(p)), None)
    if prefix is None:
        return result
    parts = value[len(prefix):].split('/')
    if not parts or len(parts) > 16 or not all(
            re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_+.,@-]{1,96}', part) is not None
            and part not in ('.', '..') for part in parts):
        return result
    if prefix in library_prefixes and re.fullmatch(
            r'lib[A-Za-z0-9_+.-]{1,120}\.dylib', parts[-1]) is None:
        return result
    return {'recognized': True, 'kind': 'public_system_or_library_path',
            'value': value, 'prefix': prefix}

def node_log_vocabulary(message):
    # This never returns the input message, an arbitrary substring, or its hash.
    patterns = {
        'libignition': r'\b(?:libignition|ignition_halt|boot_boot|ignite|ignition)\b',
        'dyld_cache': r'\b(?:dyld|CacheFinder|shared cache|shared_cache|dyld_shared_cache)\b',
        'cryptex_or_preboot': r'\b(?:cryptex|cryptexes|preboot|os graft|os_graft)\b',
        'sandbox_deny': r'\b(?:sandbox|deny|denied|Sandbox restriction)\b',
        'permission_error': r'\b(?:Permission denied|Operation not permitted|EACCES|EPERM)\b',
        'missing_resource': r'\b(?:No such file or directory|not found|ENOENT)\b',
        'missing_library_or_symbol': r'\b(?:Library not loaded|Symbol not found|missing symbol|unresolved symbol)\b',
        'code_signing': r'\b(?:code signature|code signing|codesign|signature invalid|invalid signature)\b',
        'mapping_or_memory': r'\b(?:mmap|mapping|ENOMEM|out of memory|shared_region)\b',
        'mach_or_bootstrap': r'\b(?:mach-lookup|bootstrap_look_up|bootstrap|mach service)\b',
        'thread_or_lock': r'\b(?:pthread|mutex|semaphore|deadlock|lock)\b',
        'initialization_failure': r'\b(?:initialization failed|initialisation failed|boot failed|failed to initialize)\b',
        'timeout_or_cancel': r'\b(?:timed out|timeout|ETIMEDOUT|ECANCELED|cancelled|canceled)\b',
    }
    categories = {key: re.search(pattern, message, re.IGNORECASE) is not None
                  for key, pattern in patterns.items()}
    errno_names = ('EPERM', 'ENOENT', 'EIO', 'ENXIO', 'ENOEXEC', 'EBADF',
                   'ENOMEM', 'EACCES', 'EFAULT', 'EBUSY', 'EXDEV', 'ENODEV',
                   'ENOTDIR', 'EISDIR', 'EINVAL', 'EMFILE', 'ENOSPC',
                   'EROFS', 'EPIPE', 'ENOTSUP', 'ETIMEDOUT', 'ECONNREFUSED',
                   'EBADEXEC', 'EBADARCH', 'EBADMACHO', 'ECANCELED', 'EIDRM')
    errno_symbols = [name for name in errno_names
                     if re.search(r'\b' + name + r'\b', message) is not None]
    numbers = []
    for match in re.finditer(
            r'\b(errno|error|err|result|status|code|returned)(?:\s*[=:]\s*|\s+)'
            r'(-?[0-9]{1,10}|0x[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,8})(?![A-Za-z0-9_])',
            message, re.IGNORECASE):
        need(len(numbers) < 8, 'bounded_numeric_contexts')
        literal = match.group(2)
        number = int(literal, 16) if literal.lower().startswith('0x') else int(literal, 10)
        numbers.append({'context': match.group(1).lower(), 'value': number,
                        'isExplicitErrnoContext': match.group(1).lower() == 'errno'})
    operations = ('file-read-data', 'file-read-metadata', 'file-map-executable',
                  'mach-lookup', 'sysctl-read', 'process-exec', 'process-fork',
                  'ipc-posix-shm-read-data', 'network-outbound')
    operation_mentions = [name for name in operations if re.search(
        r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_-])' + re.escape(name) + r'(?![A-Za-z0-9_-])', message)]
    denials = []
    for match in re.finditer(
            r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.-])node\(51494\)\s+deny(?:\(([0-9]{1,5})\))?'
            r'\s+([a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63})(?![a-z0-9-])(?:\s+(\S{1,512})(?!\S))?', message):
        need(len(denials) < 4, 'bounded_sandbox_denial_records')
        operation = match.group(2) if match.group(2) in operations else None
        resource = public_resource(match.group(3), operation)
        denials.append({'subjectIsFixedNodePid': True,
                       'denialNumber': int(match.group(1)) if match.group(1) is not None else None,
                       'operation': operation, 'operationRecognized': operation is not None,
                       'resource': resource, 'unknownResourceNotExported': not resource['recognized']})
    resources = []
    unknown_resources = 0
    candidate_count = 0
    seen = set()
    for match in re.finditer(
            r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_+.,@/\-])(?:@rpath/|/)[^\s"<>\(\)\[\]\{\};,:]{1,511}'
            r'(?![^\s"<>\(\)\[\]\{\};,:])', message):
        candidate_count += 1
        need(candidate_count <= 32, 'bounded_resource_candidates')
        candidate = match.group(0)
        projected = public_resource(candidate, 'path')
        if projected['recognized']:
            key = (projected['kind'], projected['value'])
            if key not in seen:
                need(len(resources) < 8, 'bounded_public_resources')
                seen.add(key)
                resources.append(projected)
        else:
            unknown_resources += 1
    return {'categoryMentions': categories, 'errnoSymbolMentions': errno_symbols,
            'numericContexts': numbers, 'terminationCodeIsNotAssumedErrno': True,
            'operationMentions': operation_mentions, 'sandboxDenialRecords': denials,
            'publicResources': resources, 'unexportedResourceCandidateCount': unknown_resources,
            'redactionMarkerPresent': '<private>' in message or '<redacted>' in message,
            'knownInputPathMentions': {name: path in message for name, path in KNOWN_MESSAGE_PATHS.items()},
            'rawMessageExported': False, 'unknownTextOrHashExported': False,
            'lexicalEvidenceOnly': True}

def node_log_record(item, ordinal):
    message_keys = ('eventMessage', 'message', 'composedMessage')
    pid_keys = ('processID', 'processIdentifier', 'pid')
    known_keys = message_keys + ('process', 'processImagePath', 'timestamp') + pid_keys
    fields = {key: {'present': key in item,
                    'jsonType': known_json_type(item[key]) if key in item else 'absent'}
              for key in known_keys}
    messages = [item[key] for key in message_keys if key in item]
    message_ok = bool(messages and all(type(value) is str for value in messages)
                      and all(value == messages[0] for value in messages))
    process_values = []
    process_types_ok = True
    if 'process' in item:
        process_types_ok = process_types_ok and type(item['process']) is str
        if type(item['process']) is str:
            process_values.append(item['process'])
    if 'processImagePath' in item:
        process_types_ok = process_types_ok and type(item['processImagePath']) is str
        if type(item['processImagePath']) is str:
            process_values.append(item['processImagePath'].rsplit('/', 1)[-1])
    process_ok = bool(process_types_ok and process_values
                      and all(value == process_values[0] for value in process_values)
                      and process_values[0] in ('node', 'kernel', 'sandboxd'))
    origin = process_values[0] if process_ok else None
    pid_values = [item[key] for key in pid_keys if key in item]
    pid_typed = bool(pid_values and all(type(value) is int and 0 <= value <= 2147483647
                                      for value in pid_values))
    pid_exact = bool(pid_typed and all(value == FIXED_PID for value in pid_values))
    message = messages[0] if message_ok else None
    system_subject = bool(message_ok and re.search(
        r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.-])node\(51494\)(?![A-Za-z0-9_.-])', message) is not None)
    instant = None
    timestamp_valid = False
    if type(item.get('timestamp')) is str:
        try:
            instant = log_timestamp_us(item['timestamp'])
        except (HelpRefused, ValueError, OverflowError):
            pass
        else:
            timestamp_valid = True
    within = bool(timestamp_valid and WINDOW_START_US <= instant <= WINDOW_END_US)
    subject_ok = bool((origin == 'node' and pid_exact)
                      or (origin in ('kernel', 'sandboxd') and system_subject))
    predicates = {'messageCandidatesPresentStringsEqual': message_ok,
                  'consistentClosedProcess': process_ok,
                  'numericPidCandidatesTyped': pid_typed,
                  'numericPidCandidatesExactly51494': pid_exact,
                  'systemMessageContainsFullNode51494Subject': system_subject,
                  'timestampParsed': timestamp_valid, 'timestampWithinOriginalWindow': within,
                  'subjectAdmission': subject_ok}
    reasons = []
    for ok, code in ((message_ok, 'message_semantics_unknown'),
                     (process_ok, 'process_origin_unknown'),
                     (timestamp_valid, 'timestamp_unknown'),
                     (within, 'outside_original_window'),
                     (subject_ok, 'fixed_node_subject_not_admitted')):
        if not ok:
            reasons.append(code)
    result = {'ordinal': ordinal, 'knownFields': fields, 'admissionPredicates': predicates,
              'origin': origin, 'admitted': not reasons, 'rejectionReasons': reasons,
              'unknownKeyNamesPublished': False, 'arbitraryFieldValuesPublished': False}
    if reasons:
        result['meaning'] = 'unknown_object_not_admitted'
        return result
    result['microsecondsFromWindowStart'] = instant - WINDOW_START_US
    result['projection'] = node_log_vocabulary(message)
    return result

def node_log_projection(out, err, row):
    need(len(out) + len(err) <= MAX_LOG_STREAM, 'bounded_log_combined_streams')
    need(not row['outcomeUnknown'] and row['completeBeforeDeadline']
         and row['exitCode'] == 0 and not err, 'log_query_known_zero_complete')
    value = out.decode('utf-8', 'strict')
    lines = [line for line in value.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    need(len(lines) <= MAX_LOG_ROWS, 'bounded_log_record_count')
    rows = []
    for ordinal, line in enumerate(lines):
        remaining()
        need(len(line.encode('utf-8')) <= MAX_LOG_LINE, 'bounded_log_json_line')
        item = json.loads(line, object_pairs_hook=unique_log_object,
                          parse_constant=lambda _value: need(False, 'finite_log_json'))
        need(type(item) is dict, 'log_record_object')
        rows.append(node_log_record(item, ordinal))
        remaining()
    admitted = sum(1 for row in rows if row['admitted'])
    return {'argv': QUERY_ARGV, 'fixedPublicNodePid': FIXED_PID,
            'observedObjects': len(rows), 'admittedEvents': admitted,
            'rejectedUnknownObjects': len(rows) - admitted, 'rows': rows,
            'allObservedObjectsAdmitted': admitted == len(rows),
            'originalWindowMilliseconds': 2000, 'queryCompleteBeforeDeadline': True,
            'rawLogTextExported': False, 'rawOrUnknownLogHashExported': False,
            'unknownObjectSemanticsQualified': False, 'wholeLogFullyClassified': False,
            'noMatchesDoesNotProveAbsence': True,
            'originalCrashPathCorrelationQualified': False,
            'originalBusinessProgressQualified': False,
            'startupCauseQualified': False, 'historicalLineageClosureQualified': False,
            'freshLogObservationNotOriginalCapturedStreamRecovery': True,
            'publicResourceNamesDoNotQualifyResourceFileContents': True,
            'classificationIsLexicalEvidenceNotRootCauseProof': True}

def command_public(commands):
    value = commands.public()
    # Unexpected child bytes are neither copied nor hashed into the outer public report.
    for row in value['commands']:
        if row is not None:
            row.pop('stdoutSha256', None)
            row.pop('stderrSha256', None)
    return value

def close_rows():
    errors = []
    for row in reversed(file_rows):
        if not row['created'] or row['closeAttempted']:
            continue
        try:
            with signals.critical():
                row['closeAttempted'] = True
                os.close(row['fd'])
                row['closed'] = True
        except BaseException as error:
            errors.append(public_error(error))
    return errors

def main():
    global signals
    commands = None
    original_handlers = {}
    installed = False
    complete = False
    result = {'schema': 'heptabao.mac-public-node-ignition-log-diagnosis.r1',
        'ok': False, 'outcomeUnknown': False, 'newSharedSeconds': 45, 'outerSeconds': 60,
        'exactLogQueryArgv': QUERY_ARGV, 'logQueryExecuted': False, 'logQueryAttempted': False, 'directoryEnumeration': False,
        'directApplicationPrivateFileOrCapsuleRead': False, 'serviceMutationAttempted': False,
        'sdkOrProviderExecuted': False, 'oldLabelCleanupAttempted': False,
        'historicalLineageClosureQualified': False, 'startupCauseQualified': False,
        'applicationFileDescriptorScopeOnly': True, 'toolInternalIoNotSyscallTraced': True}
    try:
        need(sys.platform == 'darwin' and os.getuid() == 501 and os.geteuid() == 501,
             'fixed_mac_uid')
        need(os.path.normpath(sys.executable) == PYTHON, 'fixed_regular_python')
        admit_binding()
        Signals, Commands = load_helpers()
        signals = Signals()
        original_handlers = {sig: signal.getsignal(sig) for sig in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT)}
        installed = True
        signals.install()
        commands = Commands(signals)
        root = open_fixed('/', '/', None, True)
        usr = open_fixed('/usr', 'usr', root['fd'], True)
        directory = open_fixed('/usr/bin', 'bin', usr['fd'], True)
        tool = open_fixed(LOG_PATH, 'log', directory['fd'], False)
        verify_all()
        result['toolCode'] = hash_tool(tool)
        verify_all()
        result['logQueryAttempted'] = True
        row, out, err = commands.run('fixed-public-node-two-second-log', list(QUERY_ARGV),
            until=min(UNTIL, time.monotonic() + 10.0), maximum=MAX_LOG_STREAM)
        result['logEventObservation'] = node_log_projection(out, err, row)
        verify_all()
        remaining()
        complete = True
    except BaseException as error:
        result['error'] = public_error(error)
    finally:
        if file_rows and all(row['created'] and not row['closeAttempted'] for row in file_rows):
            try:
                verify_all()
            except BaseException as error:
                result['finalIdentityError'] = public_error(error)
        result['closeErrors'] = close_rows()
        result['fileDescriptors'] = [{k: row[k] for k in ('path', 'directory', 'created',
            'openAttempted', 'closeAttempted', 'closed', 'beforeIdentity')} for row in file_rows]
        if commands is not None:
            result['commands'] = command_public(commands)
            result['logQueryExecuted'] = bool(result['commands']['commands'])
        restore_errors = []
        if installed:
            for sig, old in original_handlers.items():
                try:
                    signal.signal(sig, old)
                except BaseException as error:
                    restore_errors.append(public_error(error))
        result['signalRestoreErrors'] = restore_errors
        result['pendingSignalAfterRestore'] = None if signals is None else signals.pending
        descriptors_closed = all(not row['created'] or row['closed'] for row in file_rows)
        state = result.get('commands')
        helpers_closed = commands is None or (state['allOwnedCommandsStopped']
                                               and state['unknownCommandCount'] == 0)
        final_clock = time.monotonic()
        result['elapsedSeconds'] = final_clock - START
        result['deadlineMetAfterClosure'] = final_clock < UNTIL
        result['allApplicationDescriptorsClosed'] = descriptors_closed
        result['allOwnedLogChildrenClosed'] = helpers_closed
        result['budget'] = dict(budget)
        result['outcomeUnknown'] = bool(not descriptors_closed or not helpers_closed
            or result['closeErrors'] or restore_errors
            or (signals is not None and signals.pending is not None))
        result['ok'] = bool(complete and not result['outcomeUnknown']
            and final_clock < UNTIL and 'error' not in result and 'finalIdentityError' not in result)
    encoded = (json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False)
               + '\n').encode()
    if len(encoded) > MAX_PUBLIC_OUTPUT:
        return 1
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(encoded)
    sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
    if time.monotonic() >= UNTIL or (signals is not None and signals.pending is not None):
        return 1
    return 0 if result['ok'] else 1

if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
